table asset_positions.sql:
CREATE TABLE asset_positions (
  asset_id UUID NOT NULL,
  place_id UUID NOT NULL,
  site_id UUID NOT NULL,
  valid_from TEXT NOT NULL,
  valid_to TEXT,
  created_by UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id),
  reason TEXT,
  recorded_path TEXT NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (asset_id, valid_from),
  FOREIGN KEY (site_id, asset_id) REFERENCES assets(site_id, id),
  FOREIGN KEY (site_id, place_id) REFERENCES places(site_id, id),
  CHECK (valid_to > valid_from)
)

table assets.sql:
CREATE TABLE assets (
  id UUID PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,
  site_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES sites(id),
  tag TEXT NOT NULL,
  name TEXT NOT NULL,
  category TEXT NOT NULL,
  status TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (status IN ('planned', 'installed', 'replaced', 'decommissioned')),
  serial_number TEXT,
  manufacturer TEXT,
  model TEXT,
  installed_on TEXT,
  commissioned_on TEXT,
  warranty_start TEXT,
  warranty_end TEXT,
  warranty_provider TEXT,
  archived_at TEXT,
  created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
  updated_at TEXT NOT NULL,
  UNIQUE (site_id, id),
  CHECK (warranty_end >= warranty_start),
  CHECK (status <> 'installed' OR installed_on IS NOT NULL)
)

table assistant_usage.sql:
CREATE TABLE assistant_usage (
  id TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,
  site_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES sites(id),
  user_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  requested_at TEXT NOT NULL,
  model TEXT NOT NULL,
  input_tokens INTEGER CHECK (input_tokens >= 0),
  output_tokens INTEGER CHECK (output_tokens >= 0),
  cost_nanousd INTEGER CHECK (cost_nanousd >= 0),
  reason TEXT,
  CHECK ((cost_nanousd IS NULL AND reason IS NOT NULL) OR
    (cost_nanousd IS NOT NULL AND reason IS NULL AND input_tokens IS NOT NULL AND output_tokens IS NOT NULL))
)

table attachments.sql:
CREATE TABLE "attachments" (
  id TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,
  site_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES sites(id),
  entity_type TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (entity_type IN ('task', 'diary', 'site', 'hse_event', 'hse_inspection', 'deviation')),
  entity_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  filename TEXT NOT NULL,
  mime TEXT NOT NULL,
  size INTEGER NOT NULL,
  content_sha256 TEXT NOT NULL,
  storage_locator TEXT NOT NULL,
  manifest_version TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'v1',
  uploaded_by TEXT REFERENCES users(id),
  created_at TEXT NOT NULL
)

table audit_events.sql:
CREATE TABLE "audit_events" (
  id TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,
  site_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES sites(id),
  entity_type TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (entity_type IN ('hse_event', 'certification', 'tool', 'site', 'hse_asset', 'hse_inspection', 'purchase_order', 'purchase_order_item', 'package', 'package_item', 'shipment', 'shipment_receipt', 'deviation', 'task', 'place', 'asset')),
  entity_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  action TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (action IN ('create', 'update', 'delete', 'read', 'move', 'archive')),
  at TEXT NOT NULL,
  actor TEXT NOT NULL,
  changes TEXT NOT NULL
)

table auth_events.sql:
CREATE TABLE auth_events (
  id TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,
  user_id TEXT,
  event TEXT NOT NULL,
  outcome TEXT NOT NULL,
  ip TEXT,
  user_agent TEXT,
  detail_json TEXT NOT NULL,
  created_at TEXT NOT NULL
)

table cost_impact_deviations.sql:
CREATE TABLE cost_impact_deviations (
  cost_impact_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES cost_impacts(id),
  deviation_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES deviations(id),
  PRIMARY KEY (cost_impact_id, deviation_id)
)

table cost_impacts.sql:
CREATE TABLE cost_impacts (
  id TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,
  site_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES sites(id),
  title TEXT NOT NULL,
  status TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (status IN ('open', 'notification_sent', 'submitted', 'closed')),
  claim_amount NUMERIC,
  settlement_amount NUMERIC,
  result TEXT CHECK (result IN ('settled', 'dropped', 'rejected')),
  created_by TEXT REFERENCES users(id),
  created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
  closed_at TEXT,
  CHECK (status <> 'closed' OR result IS NOT NULL)
)

table dashboard_layouts.sql:
CREATE TABLE dashboard_layouts (
  id TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,
  site_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES sites(id),
  owner_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id),
  widgets_json TEXT NOT NULL,
  created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
  updated_at TEXT NOT NULL,
  UNIQUE (site_id, owner_id)
)

table demo_seed_environment.sql:
CREATE TABLE demo_seed_environment (
  singleton INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY CHECK (singleton = 1),
  marker TEXT NOT NULL
)

table demo_seed_records.sql:
CREATE TABLE demo_seed_records (
  table_name TEXT NOT NULL,
  record_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (table_name, record_id)
)

table deviation_events.sql:
CREATE TABLE deviation_events (
  id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
  deviation_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES deviations(id),
  at TEXT NOT NULL,
  actor TEXT NOT NULL,
  actor_id TEXT REFERENCES users(id),
  source TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (source IN ('import', 'internal')),
  from_status TEXT,
  to_status TEXT NOT NULL,
  action TEXT,
  note TEXT,
  CHECK ((source = 'import' AND actor = 'import' AND actor_id IS NULL)
      OR (source = 'internal' AND actor_id IS NOT NULL))
)

table deviation_export_rows.sql:
CREATE TABLE deviation_export_rows (
  export_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES deviation_exports(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  deviation_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES deviations(id),
  PRIMARY KEY (export_id, deviation_id)
)

table deviation_exports.sql:
CREATE TABLE deviation_exports (
  id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
  site_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES sites(id),
  source_system TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (source_system IN ('internal', 'other')),
  export_date TEXT NOT NULL,
  file_sha256 TEXT NOT NULL,
  complete BOOLEAN NOT NULL,
  scope TEXT NOT NULL,
  UNIQUE (site_id, source_system, export_date, file_sha256, complete, scope)
)

table deviation_import_sources.sql:
CREATE TABLE deviation_import_sources (
  site_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL REFERENCES sites(id),
  scope_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  run_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  promoted_run_id TEXT,
  promoted_batch_id TEXT,
  promoted_at TEXT,
  created_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  updated_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
)

table deviation_links.sql:
CREATE TABLE deviation_links (
  deviation_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES deviations(id),
  entity_type TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (entity_type IN ('site_progress_item', 'work_day', 'task', 'diary')),
  entity_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (deviation_id, entity_type, entity_id)
)

table deviations.sql:
CREATE TABLE "deviations" (
  id TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,
  site_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES sites(id),
  deviation_no TEXT, title TEXT, problem_description TEXT,
  status TEXT CHECK (status IN ('open', 'approved', 'in_progress', 'work_completed', 'closed', 'rejected')),
  priority TEXT, author TEXT, assigned_to TEXT, plc_area TEXT,
  creation_date TEXT, due_date TEXT, approved_date TEXT, closed_date TEXT,
  actual_cost NUMERIC, claim_quantity NUMERIC, labor_hours NUMERIC, completed_tasks_pct NUMERIC,
  source_entity_key_id TEXT,
  created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
  source_system TEXT CHECK (source_system IN ('internal', 'other')),
  source_id TEXT CHECK (source_id IS NULL OR (source_system IS NOT NULL AND length(trim(source_id)) > 0)),
  source_status TEXT,
  source_export_date TEXT,
  last_seen_in_export_date TEXT,
  provenance TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'original' CHECK (provenance IN ('original', 'derived', 'reported')),
  causing_company TEXT,
  resolving_company TEXT,
  attribution_state TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'not_determined' CHECK (attribution_state IN ('not_determined', 'agreed', 'disputed')),
  internal_owner_id TEXT REFERENCES users(id),
  internal_owner_since TEXT
)

table diary.sql:
CREATE TABLE diary (
  id TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,
  site_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES sites(id),
  operational_date TEXT NOT NULL,
  shift TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (shift IN ('day', 'night')),
  plan TEXT,
  actual TEXT,
  impediments TEXT,
  next_step TEXT,
  created_at TEXT NOT NULL, time_zone TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'Europe/Rome', day_cutoff_time TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '06:00', author_id TEXT REFERENCES users(id), recording_motivation TEXT, recorded_late BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT FALSE CHECK (recorded_late IN (0, 1)), updated_at TEXT, updated_by TEXT REFERENCES users(id),
  UNIQUE (site_id, operational_date, shift)
)

table diary_entry_versions.sql:
CREATE TABLE diary_entry_versions (
  id TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,
  diary_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES diary(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT,
  version INTEGER NOT NULL,
  snapshot TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (json_valid(snapshot)),
  author_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id),
  created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
  motivation TEXT,
  UNIQUE (diary_id, version)
)

table employee_certifications.sql:
CREATE TABLE employee_certifications (
  id TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,
  site_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES sites(id),
  employee_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES employees(id),
  category TEXT NOT NULL,
  name TEXT NOT NULL,
  issuer TEXT,
  issued_on TEXT,
  expires_on TEXT,
  outcome TEXT,
  notes TEXT,
  created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
  updated_at TEXT NOT NULL
, deleted_at TEXT)

table employees.sql:
CREATE TABLE employees (
  id TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,
  site_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES sites(id),
  employee_no TEXT NOT NULL,
  first_name TEXT, last_name TEXT,
  company TEXT, qualification TEXT, supervisor TEXT, team TEXT,
  hire_date TEXT, expire_date TEXT,
  source_entity_key_id TEXT,
  created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
  UNIQUE (site_id, employee_no)
)

table hr_import_sources.sql:
CREATE TABLE hr_import_sources (
  site_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL REFERENCES sites(id),
  scope_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  run_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  promoted_run_id TEXT,
  promoted_employees_batch_id TEXT,
  promoted_work_days_batch_id TEXT,
  promoted_at TEXT
)

table hse_assets.sql:
CREATE TABLE hse_assets (
  id UUID PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,
  site_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES sites(id),
  kind TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (kind IN ('tool', 'site_work', 'ppe')),
  category TEXT NOT NULL,
  name TEXT NOT NULL,
  code TEXT,
  tool_id UUID REFERENCES tools(id),
  template_code TEXT NOT NULL,
  active INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,
  notes TEXT,
  deleted_at TEXT,
  created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
  updated_at TEXT NOT NULL,
  UNIQUE (site_id, name)
)

table hse_events.sql:
CREATE TABLE hse_events (
  id TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,
  site_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES sites(id),
  event_no TEXT,
  type TEXT NOT NULL,
  severity TEXT NOT NULL,
  occurred_on DATE NOT NULL,
  location TEXT,
  persons_involved INTEGER,
  measures TEXT,
  notes TEXT,
  deviation_id TEXT REFERENCES deviations(id),
  created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
  updated_at TEXT NOT NULL,
  deleted_at TEXT,
  UNIQUE (site_id, event_no)
)

table hse_inspection_items.sql:
CREATE TABLE hse_inspection_items (
  id TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,
  inspection_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES hse_inspections(id),
  item_code TEXT NOT NULL,
  label TEXT NOT NULL,
  result TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (result IN ('ok', 'not_ok', 'na')),
  note TEXT,
  position INTEGER NOT NULL,
  UNIQUE (inspection_id, item_code)
)

table hse_inspections.sql:
CREATE TABLE hse_inspections (
  id TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,
  site_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES sites(id),
  asset_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES hse_assets(id),
  performed_on DATE NOT NULL,
  performed_by TEXT NOT NULL,
  performer_role TEXT,
  mode TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (mode IN ('internal', 'external')),
  outcome TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (outcome IN ('pass', 'pass_with_notes', 'fail')),
  notes TEXT,
  next_due_on DATE,
  hse_event_id TEXT,
  created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
  updated_at TEXT NOT NULL
, computed_outcome TEXT, declared_outcome TEXT, outcome_source TEXT, template_status TEXT)

table idempotency_keys.sql:
CREATE TABLE idempotency_keys (

table import_mappings.sql:
CREATE TABLE import_mappings (
  id TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,
  site_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES sites(id),
  family TEXT NOT NULL,
  aliases_json TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}',
  identity_json TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]',
  created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
  updated_at TEXT NOT NULL,

table invitations.sql:
CREATE TABLE invitations (
  id TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,
  email TEXT NOT NULL,
  token_hash TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
  created_by TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id),
  created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
  expires_at TEXT NOT NULL,
  used_at TEXT,
  revoked_at TEXT,
  locale TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'en' CHECK (locale IN ('it', 'en')),
  site_id TEXT REFERENCES sites(id) ON DELETE SET NULL,
  site_role TEXT CHECK (site_role IN ('owner', 'editor', 'verifier', 'viewer', 'demo_user')),
  delivery_status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending' CHECK (delivery_status IN ('pending', 'sent', 'failed')),
  delivery_attempts INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (delivery_attempts >= 0),
  delivered_at TEXT,
  last_delivery_error TEXT

table jurisdictions.sql:
CREATE TABLE jurisdictions (

  label_it TEXT NOT NULL,

table member_module_access.sql:
CREATE TABLE member_module_access (

  allowed BOOLEAN NOT NULL CHECK (allowed IN (0, 1)),
  created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
  updated_at TEXT NOT NULL,

  quantity_packed NUMERIC(12,3) NOT NULL CHECK (quantity_packed > 0),
  unit TEXT,
  material_no TEXT,
  description TEXT NOT NULL,
  created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
  UNIQUE (package_id, purchase_order_item_id)

table packages.sql:
CREATE TABLE packages (

  site_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES sites(id),

  package_no TEXT NOT NULL,
  status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'open' CHECK (status IN ('open', 'closed')),

  updated_at TEXT NOT NULL,
  UNIQUE (purchase_order_id, package_no)

table password_resets.sql:

table places.sql:
CREATE TABLE places (

  archived_at TEXT,

  FOREIGN KEY (site_id, parent_id) REFERENCES places(site_id, id),
  CHECK (parent_id <> id)
)

table planning_import_keys.sql:
CREATE TABLE planning_import_keys (

  import_key TEXT NOT NULL,
  target_id TEXT NOT NULL,

  last_import_run_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
  updated_at TEXT NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (site_id, family, import_key),
  UNIQUE (site_id, family, target_id),
  FOREIGN KEY (site_id, last_import_run_id) REFERENCES planning_import_runs(site_id, id)
)

table planning_import_runs.sql:
CREATE TABLE planning_import_runs (

  filename TEXT,
  file_sha256 TEXT,
  file_data BLOB,
  created_by TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id),
  created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
  counts_json TEXT,
  applied_keys_json TEXT,
  UNIQUE (site_id, id)
)

table progress_entries.sql:
CREATE TABLE progress_entries (
  id UUID PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,

table progress_type_steps.sql:
CREATE TABLE progress_type_steps (

table progress_types.sql:

table project_structure.sql:
CREATE TABLE "project_structure" (
  id TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,
  site_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES sites(id),
  parent_id TEXT REFERENCES project_structure(id),
  source_uuid TEXT,
  wbs_code TEXT NOT NULL,
  description TEXT,
  level INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (level >= 0),
  sort_order INTEGER,
  summary_task BOOLEAN,
  progress_pct NUMERIC,
  planned_start TEXT, planned_finish TEXT,
  actual_start TEXT, actual_finish TEXT,
  planned_hours NUMERIC,
  section TEXT, plc_area TEXT, assigned_to TEXT,

  source_entity_key_id TEXT,

  updated_at TEXT,
  updated_by TEXT REFERENCES users(id),

  source_run_id TEXT,

  UNIQUE (site_id, source_uuid),

table purchase_order_items.sql:

table purchase_orders.sql:

table reconciliation_adoptions.sql:
CREATE TABLE reconciliation_adoptions (

table reconciliation_batches.sql:

table registry_account_links.sql:

table registry_affiliations.sql:

table registry_authority_delegations.sql:

CREATE TABLE site_progress_item_steps (

table site_progress_items.sql:
CREATE TABLE "site_progress_items" (
  id TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,
  site_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES sites(id),

  description TEXT,
  plc_area TEXT,
  section TEXT,
  progress_pct NUMERIC,

  planned_finish TEXT,
  actual_start TEXT,
  expected_delay TEXT,
  has_files BOOLEAN,
  has_notes BOOLEAN,

  source_row INTEGER NOT NULL,
  source_entity_key_id TEXT,
  created_at TEXT NOT NULL,

  planned_hours NUMERIC,
  UNIQUE (site_id, source_row),
  UNIQUE (id, site_id),
  FOREIGN KEY (wbs_id, site_id) REFERENCES project_structure(id, site_id)
)

table sites.sql:
CREATE TABLE sites (
  id TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,
  code TEXT UNIQUE NOT NULL,
  name TEXT NOT NULL,
  location TEXT,
  start_date TEXT,
  end_date TEXT,
  created_at TEXT NOT NULL
, jurisdiction TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'IT' CHECK (jurisdiction IN ('IT', 'UK')), time_zone TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'Europe/Rome'
  CHECK (time_zone GLOB '[A-Za-z]*' AND time_zone NOT GLOB '*[^A-Za-z0-9_+/-]*'
    AND time_zone NOT LIKE '%//%' AND time_zone NOT LIKE '%/'), day_cutoff_time TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '06:00'
  CHECK (day_cutoff_time GLOB '[0-2][0-9]:[0-5][0-9]' AND day_cutoff_time < '24:00'), assistant_enabled BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT FALSE
  CHECK (assistant_enabled IN (FALSE, TRUE)), assistant_timeout_ms INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 20000
  CHECK (typeof(assistant_timeout_ms) = 'integer' AND assistant_timeout_ms BETWEEN 5000 AND 60000), demo_sandbox BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT FALSE CHECK (demo_sandbox IN (0, 1)), jurisdiction_code TEXT REFERENCES jurisdictions(code), content_language TEXT CHECK (content_language IN ('it', 'en')))

table task_events.sql:
CREATE TABLE task_events (
  id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
  task_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES tasks(id),
  at TEXT NOT NULL,
  actor TEXT NOT NULL,
  from_status TEXT NOT NULL,
  to_status TEXT NOT NULL,
  note TEXT,
  reason TEXT
, action TEXT NULL
  CHECK (action IN ('create', 'start', 'submit', 'verify', 'reject',
    'block', 'resume', 'reopen', 'close')), waiver BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT FALSE
  CHECK (NOT waiver OR (action IS NOT NULL AND action = 'close' AND reason IS NOT NULL AND length(trim(reason)) >= 15)), evidence_attachment_id TEXT REFERENCES attachments(id))

table tasks.sql:
CREATE TABLE "tasks" (
  id TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,
  site_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES sites(id),
  title TEXT NOT NULL,
  area TEXT,
  company TEXT,
  executor TEXT NOT NULL,
  verifier TEXT NOT NULL,
  priority TEXT,
  due_date TEXT,
  status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'todo'
    CHECK (status IN ('todo', 'in_progress', 'to_verify', 'closed', 'blocked')),
  created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
  blocked_from TEXT,
  submitted_by TEXT,
  executor_id TEXT REFERENCES users(id),
  verifier_id TEXT REFERENCES users(id),
  submitted_by_id TEXT REFERENCES users(id),
  kind TEXT,
  wbs_id TEXT, declared_at TEXT, verified_at TEXT, acceptance_document_id TEXT REFERENCES attachments(id), acceptance_date TEXT, acceptance_state TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'none'
  CHECK (acceptance_state IN ('none', 'declared', 'accepted')
    AND (acceptance_state <> 'accepted' OR (acceptance_document_id IS NOT NULL AND acceptance_date IS NOT NULL))),
  FOREIGN KEY (wbs_id, site_id) REFERENCES project_structure(id, site_id)
)

table time_bookings.sql:
CREATE TABLE "time_bookings" (
  id TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,
  site_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES sites(id),
  work_day_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES work_days(id),
  site_progress_item_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES site_progress_items(id),
  hours NUMERIC NOT NULL CHECK (hours >= 0),
  created_by TEXT REFERENCES users(id),
  created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
  FOREIGN KEY (site_progress_item_id, site_id) REFERENCES site_progress_items(id, site_id),
  UNIQUE (work_day_id, site_progress_item_id),
  FOREIGN KEY (work_day_id, site_id) REFERENCES work_days(id, site_id)
)

table tool_company_links.sql:
CREATE TABLE tool_company_links (

  company_id UUID NOT NULL,
  company_label TEXT NOT NULL,
  relationship TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (relationship IN ('owner', 'custodian', 'supplier')),

table tools.sql:
CREATE TABLE tools (

table wbs_import_sources.sql:

END

trigger deviations_source_identity.sql:
CREATE TRIGGER deviations_source_identity BEFORE UPDATE OF source_id, source_system, site_id ON deviations
WHEN OLD.source_id IS NOT NULL
  AND (NEW.source_id IS NOT OLD.source_id OR NEW.source_system IS NOT OLD.source_system OR NEW.site_id IS NOT OLD.site_id)
BEGIN
  SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'Deviation source identity is immutable');
END

view accessible_site_members.sql:
CREATE VIEW accessible_site_members AS
SELECT m.site_id, m.user_id, m.role
FROM site_members m JOIN users u ON u.id = m.user_id JOIN sites s ON s.id = m.site_id
WHERE (NOT u.demo_sandbox AND m.role <> 'demo_user')
   OR (u.demo_sandbox AND s.demo_sandbox AND m.role <> 'owner')
